notes: Dating bars: once it's official, three small bars sit under their name in the with-you bar. They start black and fade into the character's color as your points grow, one bar per stage. Tap anyone's name there to open their relationship card: trust, mood, dating stage, points and how far to the next stage, recent ups and downs, what they've told you they want, their goal, inside jokes, secrets, promises and their tell. Tone: someone you mildly irritate may go a little tsundere, if it fits them.
